minutes.headline: Committee voted to send its new program submission policy to town legal review; manager to brief the building committee on a studio.
minutes.summary: The Public Access Cable Committee heard the manager's report on the audio upgrade, finances, a drone wish list and a carpet donation. It discussed the municipal building design committee's request for studio requirements, then spent most of the meeting on a draft program submission policy. The committee voted to send the policy to town legal review. It also heard a Master Plan steering committee update.

budget_items.what_was_said: The building design committee asked for studio requirements; the space size and the money available to outfit it were recalled by the manager.
The audio upgrade in the meeting room was funded with ARPA money and came in under budget.
A small drone is on the wish list; licensing and insurance costs were discussed, including one-day event policies.
A new studio set carpet was on the ARPA list; the manager will look at donated industrial carpet.
The month balanced without going to the town accountant; the balance was stated.
Local programming is below the manager's preferred range.
The November Comcast payment had not been posted; an interest posting appeared for October as town interest.

The secretary will send the policy to the town manager, who wants it by January 1; the committee hopes for his opinion at the January 6 meeting.

what_happened.line: The committee voted unanimously by roll call to send its provisional program submission policy to town hall for legal review.
The secretary will send the policy to the town manager, who wants it by January 1; the committee hopes for his opinion at the January 6 meeting.
The manager was authorized to speak with the municipal building design committee about studio requirements and offered to attend in person.
The manager reported the ARPA-funded audio upgrade came in under budget, and that a drone and donated carpet are under consideration.
The month's finances balanced, though the November Comcast payment had not yet been posted.

why_it_matters: The policy will set how residents and groups get programs onto the town's public access channel, and it is now waiting on a legal opinion before it can take effect.
The studio requirements the manager gives the building design committee will shape what space, and how much funding, public access gets in a future municipal building plan.
watch_next: January 6, 2025 meeting, where the committee hopes to hear the town manager's opinion on the policy (he wants it by January 1).
